entities.summary: Kadarius Toney is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida Gators and was selected by the New York Giants in the first round of the 2021 NFL draft. He has also played in the NFL for the Kansas City Chiefs and Cleveland Browns.
